summary.text: Tawn Beliger is the Republican candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community leader from Northfield Township who served as a township trustee from 2016 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Beliger earned an associate degree from Schoolcraft Community College in 1989.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Northfield Township since 2015 with her husband Gerry.

She said she served as Northfield Township trustee from 2016 to 2020, is vice chair of the Washtenaw County Republican Committee, sits on the executive committee of the 6th Congressional District Republican Committee, and was a delegate to the 2024 Republican National Convention.
Beliger advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

She said her main objective would be reducing the cost of living, and her priorities include repealing the clean energy mandates and the 2023 red flag laws, protecting unborn children from late-term abortions for non-medical reasons, and restoring Michigan's right-to-work law.
